notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Three snapshots plus expression pedal assignment. Confirmed effect: ZVex Fuzz Factory (Industrial Fuzz — exact model available in Helix). Confirmed amp: Marshall Super Lead / Vox AC30 combination for Origin of Symmetry era (Brit Plexi Jump — removed per amp+cab policy). Expression pedal assigned to Industrial Fuzz Stability parameter — sweeps from oscillating chaos (heel, Stability ~2) to stable fuzz (toe, Stability ~8). This recreates the famous intro sweep where Bellamy tames the Fuzz Factory oscillation. IMPORTANT NOTE: Industrial Fuzz Stability parameter — lower values = more oscillation/instability (chaos), higher values = stable fuzz. The intro starts at LOW stability (chaotic oscillation) and sweeps TO high stability (controlled fuzz) as the riff begins.

signal_chain.notes: S1 nearly open — Fuzz Factory oscillation and noise is intentional, must not be gated. S2+S3 tighten.

Exact confirmed model — ZVex Fuzz Factory is the confirmed Bellamy pedal for Plug In Baby. ACTIVE in all three snapshots. Stability is the key snapshot-variable parameter: S1 uses Stability 2.0 as starting point (EXP pedal sweeps from 2.0 to 8.0 during intro). S2+S3 use fixed Stability 9.5 (fully stable fuzz). Compress, Gate, Drive, Oscillator, Level are fixed across all snapshots. NOTE: Stability values — lower = more unstable/oscillating, higher = more stable fuzz.

Compensates for removed Brit Plexi Jump and 4x12 Greenback 25 cab voicing. S1 gentle — oscillation fills sonic space without additional EQ shaping. S2+S3 push mids for the cutting, aggressive character of the Fuzz Factory into Plexi tone. High Cut rolled back in S2+S3 to control top-end harshness from fuzz.

No delay in Snapshot 1 (Mix 0%) — oscillation fills all sonic space. Tempo-synced to 120 BPM. S2: d1/16 (188ms, exact match to 187.5ms). S3: 1/8 (250ms, exact match) — slightly more spacious for chorus. Treble rolled back to keep repeats dark and not competing with the bright fuzz character.

1_oscillating_intro.Time: 375ms (d1/8 at 120 BPM — set but Mix at 0%)

signal_chain.notes: Ganymede chosen over Dynamic Hall for Plug In Baby — Origin of Symmetry era tone benefits from the smoother, less controlled reverb character. Tone parameter shapes overall brightness. S1 moderate reverb around the oscillation. S2 relatively dry — riff is aggressive and doesn't benefit from reverb wash. S3 opens up slightly for chorus.

expression_pedal.usage: Snapshot 1 ONLY — start at heel (Stability 2.0 = oscillating chaos), sweep to toe as intro progresses. Switch to Snapshot 2 as first riff note lands. In Snapshots 2+3 the Stability is fixed at 9.5 via snapshot parameter — EXP pedal has no meaningful effect.
expression_pedal.note: Industrial Fuzz auto-assigns to EXP 1 — verify this or manually assign Stability to EXP 1

1_oscillating_intro.description: Oscillating intro. Industrial Fuzz at Gate 1.5 (nearly open), Drive 10.0, Stability 2.0 — full chaotic oscillation. EXP pedal sweeps Stability from 2.0 (heel, chaos) to 8.0 (toe, stable). Gate open at -80dB. Cosmos Echo Mix 0% — no delay. Moderate reverb. Start with pedal at heel before picking any note.

2_main_riff.description: Main riff/verse. Industrial Fuzz Gate 5.5, Drive 9.0, Stability 9.5 (fully stable). EQ mid +4dB at 800Hz. d1/16 delay (188ms) at 18% mix. Relatively dry reverb (0.8 sec, 15% mix).

3_chorus.description: Chorus sections. Industrial Fuzz Compress 5.0, Drive 8.5, Level 7.5 — slightly more compression and output. EQ mid +5dB, Level +3dB. 1/8 delay (250ms) at 25% mix. More reverb (1.2 sec, 22% mix).

playing_notes.technique: Main intro riff played on high E and B strings starting at 12th fret. Practice the riff cleanly at speed BEFORE engaging the Industrial Fuzz — with oscillation active it's hard to hear individual notes clearly.
playing_notes.expression_pedal_performance: The EXP pedal sweep in Snapshot 1 is the most demanding performance element. Practice timing the sweep so toe position is reached exactly as the first main riff note lands. Switch to Snapshot 2 simultaneously. This requires coordination between the foot sweep and the footswitch press.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1: start with EXP at heel, sweep to toe across intro. Snapshot 2: main riff and verse. Snapshot 3: chorus sections.
playing_notes.fuzz_factory_note: Industrial Fuzz Stability behavior: lower values = oscillation and chaos, higher values = stable fuzz. This is counterintuitive — sweep from LOW to HIGH to go from chaos to controlled. The Stability parameter may self-oscillate differently from the real Fuzz Factory depending on your guitar output and tube amp input impedance — adjust Gate and Compress to dial in the intro oscillation character.
